subject: Follow-up: Lumenix security package request & trust portal access
messages:
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: samantha.cho@lumenix.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Lumenix security package request & trust portal access

Hi Samantha — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we stay coordinated: 

- Ask: Lumenix asked for access to our SOC 2 Type II package (latest period), a signed bridge letter, and a trust-portal dropbox for evidence ingestion.
- Timeline the prospect requested: review this week; procurement expects a short turnaround (goal: by end of next week).

Can you confirm the preferred upload method for the DDQ and whether procurement needs the bridge letter in PDF or DocuSign? If helpful, we can provision temporary read-only portal credentials and a one-time upload folder.

I copied Priyom (security intake) and Marissa (AE lead) to coordinate delivery. Proposed next steps from our side: 
1) I’ll ask security to pull the SOC 2 Type II report and a short one-page summary (controls + scope).
2) Priyom will provision trust portal access and a folder for Lumenix to upload their final DDQ.
3) Marissa will confirm commercial timing for the deal (LUM-4832).

If that sequencing looks good, I’ll flag a portal invite and attach the summary when ready.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Sales, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (stub)]
From: Samantha Cho <samantha.cho@lumenix.ai>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@lumenix.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Lumenix security package request & trust portal access

Thanks Jonas — appreciate the recap. A couple quick answers: 

- Procurement would prefer the bridge letter as a signed PDF attached to the portal (DocuSign link optional).
- For the DDQ, our security team will upload directly to a temporary portal folder. Please include an intake form or filename convention so our ops team can map documents correctly.
- Timeline: if we can get the SOC 2 artifacts and bridge letter by EOD Friday PDT, procurement can circulate internally and get back to you early next week.

CCing procurement for visibility.

Samantha
Samantha Cho
Head of IT & Security, Lumenix
samantha.cho@lumenix.ai
From: priyom.das@redwood.ai
To: jonas.weber@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 06:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Follow-up: Lumenix security package request & trust portal access

Forwarding for visibility — taking action now. 

Jonas / Marissa, I’ll do the following: 
- Provision a temporary trust portal folder for lumenix_uploads_4832 with read/write upload and 14-day retention.
- Generate a portal invite (one-time token) and add a short intake template (filename: COMPANY_DDQ_TIMESTAMP.pdf).
- Pull the latest SOC 2 Type II report and create a one-page summary callout for scope, auditor, and date. I’ll also attach a signed bridge letter (we have a standard bridge template).

Planned timeline: portal created and invite sent by 09:00 PDT; SOC 2 summary + bridge letter attached to the portal by 11:00 PDT. If procurement needs DocuSign, I can send that as well after you confirm.

Action items for Jonas: please confirm whether you want the portal invite sent to procurement@lumenix.ai only or cc Samantha as well.

--
Priyom Das
Security Intake, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trust_portal_invite.eml (stub)]
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai
To: samantha.cho@lumenix.ai, procurement@lumenix.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 19 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Lumenix security package request & trust portal access

Samantha / procurement team — sending the portal invite now. You should receive an email titled "Redwood Trust Portal — temporary upload link (Lumenix)" with a secure upload folder (expires in 14 days). Please use the intake template attached when uploading the DDQ.

Also attached: a short SOC 2 Type II summary and a signed bridge letter for your records. If procurement would prefer the bridge letter via DocuSign, reply and I’ll route it. 

Attachments: 
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
- bridge_letter_signed.pdf (PDF, signed)

Next step: procurement confirms receipt and we’ll lock a target review date. Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you want to walk through controls/scope.

Thanks,
Jonas
